title: Life Stages and Roles
text: Explore the different roles people play at various life stages and learn how to balance responsibilities effectively.
cdi_links: 3.B.05 Being aware of different life stages and life roles

title: Introduction: Life is Made of Many Roles
bullets: People take on different roles throughout their lives
Sometimes we have multiple roles at the same time (e.g., student and sibling, worker and parent)
Priorities change depending on age, goals, and responsibilities
In this lesson, you will explore the stages of life, the roles people play, balancing responsibilities, and preparing for change

title: Success Criteria
bullets: I can identify different life stages
I can explain the roles people take on in each stage
I can reflect on the roles I play now
I can consider roles I may take on in the future

title: Key Words
bullets: Life Role – A part someone plays in life, like student, worker, or parent
Balance – Managing different parts of life so they work well together
Transition – Moving from one stage or role to another

title: Quick Questions
text: What roles do you play in your life right now? (e.g., student, friend, sibling, club member, part-time worker)
Think about how these roles affect your time, energy, and responsibilities

title: Life Stages
bullets: Childhood (0–12 years)
Teenage (13–19 years)
Young Adult (20–35 years)
Middle Adulthood (36–60 years)
Older Adulthood (60+)
Retiree, worker or manager, grandparent, parent, volunteer, community member, hobbyist, mentor, student, employee, part-time worker, entrepreneur, partner, friend, family helper

title: Balancing Roles
bullets: Balancing different life roles helps you stay healthy, manage time effectively, reduce stress, and focus on priorities
Transitions happen when you move from school to work, start a family, or retire
Life changes require new responsibilities

title: Activity
text: Create a timeline of life stages and roles, identify your current roles, and reflect on how responsibilities change over time. Include discussion, sorting, and reflection as appropriate.

title: Key Takeaways
text: Being aware of life stages and roles helps you make better decisions
Understanding transitions allows you to adapt to change
